prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style educational asset graphic. A side-by-side lineup of three distinct stegosaur eggs arranged neatly on a flat, neutral light-grey studio floor. Each egg is medium-to-large sized, noticeably oblong-oval, and features a thick, heavily structured shell. From left to right: 1) A pristine, unpigmented chalky off-white egg with a subtle matte texture. 2) A heavily mineralized siderite-stained mud-brown stone egg looking like a piece of dark, solid earth rock. 3) An agatized fossil egg appearing as a solid matte tan-grey quartz stone. A single bright orange fruit sits on the far left next to the first egg for an intuitive scale reference. Background is a clean, solid empty light-grey studio setting. STUDIO_GROUNDED lighting with crisp, dark contact shadows directly underneath each object to give them a heavy physical weight. Perfectly centered 1:1 square composition, formatted as a square hero card with a strict 25% negative space buffer on all four outer boundaries. A single small black-and-white checkered scale bar spans horizontally across the bottom floor plane.
visual_logic: Presents three realistic, unpigmented shell mineralization and taphonomic rock variations within the oblong stegosaur clade, framed perfectly for a 1:1 mobile layout using an orange for scale.
style_notes: SQUARE_HERO_CARD, STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3. Ensure the aspect ratio is exactly 1:1. Only one horizontal scale bar at the very bottom edge. All items must stay within the central power-zone grid without touching the frame limits.
